 Park outside recall issued for over 700k BMW Vehicles
 Owners told to park outside and away from buildings and other vehicles until repair
 Noelle Gray , Digital Content Producer
 Published:  November 13, 2026 at 9:24 AM Tags:  Recall , BMW Three new BMW models will debut at 2014 NAIAS. WASHINGTON, D.C. – BMW of North America has issued a park outside recall notice for nearly 720,796 vehicles due to a risk of fire while the car is parked and turned off.
 These vehicles were previously recalled in 2024 for a water pump issue and must be repaired again.
 Recommended Videos
 An improperly sealed electrical connector on the water pump maybe exposed to water and short circuit increasing the risk of a fire.
 If you own one of these vehicles, you should park it outside and away from buildings and other vehicles until it is repaired.
 The recall impacts the following models:
 2012-2016 BMW 3 Series 
 2012-2016 BMW 5 Series 
 2012-2015 BMW X1 
 2012-2016 BMW Z4 
 2013-2017 BMW X3 
 2014-2016 BMW 2 Series coupe 
 2014-2016 BMW 3 Series sportswagon 
 2014-2016 BMW 328xi Gran Turismo 
 2014-2016 BMW 4 Series convertible 
 2014-2016 BMW 4 Series coupe 
 2015-2016 BMW 2 Series convertible 
 2015-2016 BMW 4 Series gran coupe 
 2015-2018 BMW X4 
 2016-2018 BMW X5 xDrive40e 
 Owners will be notified by mail starting Dec. 25, 2026. 
 Owners can contact BMW’s recall hotline at 800-525-7417 or NHTSA’s Vehicle Safety Hotline at 888-327-4236.
